summary: Iteration 28 — Google Meet / Calendar integration (gracefully inactive while GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are empty). Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_google_integration.py (22 tests). Covered /api/google status + oauth/start + oauth/callback (307 redirects for access_denied + bogus state) + disconnect role gating, /api/meetings create/patch/delete with add_google_meet (no 500, meet_link stays null since Google not configured), WhatsApp smart routing regression (iter27) and unit-level google_calendar_service with monkeypatched httpx (create_event sends conferenceData.createRequest hangoutsMeet + conferenceDataVersion=1 + sendUpdates=all, update_event PATCHes with sendUpdates=all, cancel_event DELETEs with sendUpdates=all, _event_body converts times to tenant tz Asia/Kolkata and maps attendee user ids to emails). All 22 pass. Frontend verified via Playwright: admin sees google-meet-panel on /admin/settings with 'Credentials missing' badge, connect button disabled, redirect_uri displayed; manager/employee do NOT see the panel; new meeting dialog shows google-meet-toggle-block with the checkbox disabled and helper text 'Google Meet isn't connected yet'; meeting-join-meet-{id} button renders only when meet_link is present (seeded directly in Mongo).
critical_code_review_comments: google_calendar_service.update_event sends conferenceDataVersion=1 even for a pure PATCH that doesn't change conferenceData — harmless but unnecessary; not blocking.
oauth_callback eats every exception into reason=exchange_failed; consider logging the underlying error (currently only a swallowed except Exception) to aid debugging in prod.

google_calendar_service._access_token returns None silently when refresh fails; meetings continue to be created without a meet_link but without any user-facing signal — maybe surface a one-time toast / notification to super_admin.

notify_meeting_scheduled still fires on auto_approved meetings even when add_google_meet=True and Google is connected; the WhatsApp message does not include the Meet link, so attendees get Google's native invite PLUS a separate WA message without the link. Consider adding meet_link into the WA templating.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin panel, role-gating, meetings dialog toggle, seeded join-link render all pass)
